Rosacea-associated inflammation of the conjunctiva; accompanying cutaneous rosacea is a separately diagnosed condition.

Neurodevelopmental impairment and congenital heart defects define the syndrome. Facial and pinna shape variants do not establish additional functional organ damage.
Defined by multiple hepatic cysts. Renal cysts are annotated at 30-79%, but common renal functional damage is not established in isolated polycystic liver disease.
Osteosarcoma occupies multiple skeletal sites; multifocality does not establish another organ axis.
Profound developmental impairment, epilepsy and hypomyelination define the phenotype. Hypoglutaminemia in 2/8 does not establish a common systemic metabolic phenotype.
Inherited ammonia metabolism disorder; hyperammonemic brain injury and persistent neurodevelopmental impairment affect roughly 30-60%. Hepatic enzyme location alone is not liver damage.
Proliferating vitreoretinal membranes contract and damage retinal structure and function.
Hereditary colorectal carcinoma defines the gastrointestinal axis; risks of other primary cancers do not establish involvement.
